name: John C. McGinley
summary: Dry, precise comic timing and a memorable turn as Julian in Wagons East.
personal_excerpt: His sophisticated bookseller persona and unexpected skill as a shooter make Julian one of the film's strongest reversals.

name: John Candy
summary: A uniquely warm comic performer whose work stands independently from later physical comedians.
personal_excerpt: I first became aware of him through Uncle Buck and Planes, Trains and Automobiles, then followed his earlier work.

name: Richard Lewis
summary: Deadpan anxiety, compressed storytelling, and unmistakable stand-up cadence.
personal_excerpt: His battlefield-surgeon routine in Wagons East is so deadpan and unmistakably Richard Lewis.

name: Robert Picardo
summary: A versatile character actor who moves easily between science fiction, comedy, and drama.

name: Ellen Greene
summary: A distinct voice and theatrical presence with exceptional comic timing.

name: Lochlyn Munro
summary: Especially effective at playing earnest, clueless, and likable characters.

name: Charles Rocket
summary: A sharp comic presence with a broad range of supporting roles.

name: Michael J. Fox
summary: Fast, expressive screen timing and a defining science-fiction comedy performance.

name: Christopher Lloyd
summary: A singular physical and vocal performer across comedy and genre film.

name: Robin Williams
summary: Extraordinary improvisational speed with major dramatic range.

name: Hilary Swank
summary: A performer associated with an early Grays Harbor memory and admired ever since.
personal_excerpt: While growing up in the Grays Harbor area, someone my family knew said she was related to Hilary Swank and shared family photographs. That unexpected connection led us to watch Swank's work, which I have enjoyed ever since.

name: Kristy Swanson
summary: A memorable presence in comedy and genre film.

name: Ashton Kutcher
summary: A recognizable comic performer across television and film.

name: Seann William Scott
summary: A durable comic performer with strong physical timing.

name: Christopher Walken
summary: An unmistakable voice, rhythm, and screen presence.
